works.body:
Hello.
I requested to draw four members of my own team in the Cthulhu Mythos TRPG, Lick Medicine.


*Character settings, etc.
 Natsu Tora Yasui
Leader
He has high ideals and a gentle personality that loves the members more than anything else. He is always smiling, but he is a blabbermouth and tends to be teased in general.
Image color: red

Koakuta Leo Fang
Cool and intellectual
He is a devil of fansa, though he seems to be a downer. He often engages in fangirling with the members.
He is somewhat caring and often cares about the members.
His color is turquoise blue.

Harusho Mizuki
He is always smiling and energetic!
He is friendly, cheerful, and always makes the place lively, and is loved by everyone.
His personal space is generally close.
He is surprisingly stoic, but he doesn't like to show it.
The devil of fansa
His image color is yellow💛.

Fuuka Fuyuha
Image color: purple(#dda0dd)
Overwhelmingly mensa sexy person in charge
I am pretty and beautiful.
She is always wishing to be valuable to someone.
She has a massive desire for approval.
If she were an animal, she would be a cat.
Idol is a vocation
